title: Violation
description: One finding of the rule in whose ledger row it sits: the observation of what is wrong, and where it is reported. It carries no reference of its own: the row names the rule once, and the reporting script renders the comment as '{observation} breaks {principle name}', the principle being the parent of that rule

Observation.description: What the code does wrong, briefly, worded as the subject of the sentence the reporting script completes: '{observation} breaks {principle name}'. It names no rule and no principle, by name, id, link, or wording, and it says what is wrong, not how to fix it

SurfaceAnchor.description: Lines of one surface fragment of one file, copied as they stand under review.files: the kind surface, the side, and the lines with their text. Lines of a context fragment are another kind and cannot be an anchor; lines not copied from the fragment are refused

PullRequestAnchor.description: The pull request as a whole, where no surface line is to blame: an existing component that replaces a whole module, a standard the change set as a whole does not follow, or code outside the surface that the change made dead, which the observation names by file and line. Carried in the review body rather than on a line
